environment.description: Kafka consumer running on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with a public IP. The Kafka cluster (MSK) is accessible via public bootstrap endpoints. Any authenticated Kafka producer (using SASL/SCRAM credentials that were leaked in a prior incident) can publish messages to the 'file-uploads' topic. The consumer process runs as root with full filesystem access. No AppArmor or seccomp profiles are applied.

config.kafka_access: public MSK bootstrap endpoints, SASL/SCRAM auth with compromised credentials
config.filesystem: unrestricted write access to entire filesystem
